bard.why: W, E and R deal no damage at all (shrine heal, terrain corridor, pure stasis/stun) and Q is one flat bolt (the secondary hit needs a second enemy, which a 1-dummy fight never has); the only real work is Meeps, an ammo-capped on-hit proc whose per-hit damage, stock cap and regen rate all key off a permanent Chime count the simulator has to assume for a level-16 snapshot.
